WITH account_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.account_id,
        d.A3 as region,
        COUNT(*) as order_count
    FROM `order` o
    JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count FROM account_orders
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        ao.account_id,
        ao.region,
        ao.order_count,
        ao.order_count - oa.avg_count as diff_from_overall_avg
    FROM account_orders ao
    CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
region_avg_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        AVG(diff_from_overall_avg) as region_avg_diff
    FROM with_diff
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
    wd.account_id,
    wd.region,
    wd.order_count,
    wd.diff_from_overall_avg,
    wd.diff_from_overall_avg - rad.region_avg_diff as excess
FROM with_diff wd
JOIN region_avg_diff rad ON wd.region = rad.region
WHERE wd.diff_from_overall_avg > rad.region_avg_diff
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10
